name: PROD_BASE_URL
purpose: Base URL used by read-only production smoke tests.

name: STRIPE_VAULT_PRICE_ID
purpose: Stripe recurring annual price for Galaxy Vault at $200/year.

name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
purpose: Verifies Stripe webhook events before entitlement changes.

name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
purpose: Authenticates the Vault Discord role-assignment bot.

name: DISCORD_GALAXY_GUILD_ID
purpose: Galaxy Discord server id for Vault role assignment.

name: DISCORD_VAULT_MEMBER_ROLE_ID
purpose: Discord role granted to active Vault members.

name: DISCORD_VAULT_FOUNDING_MEMBER_ROLE_ID
purpose: Discord role granted to founding Vault members.

name: TRANSACTIONAL_EMAIL_PROVIDER
purpose: Names the provider used for Vault welcome and renewal email sends.

name: TRANSACTIONAL_EMAIL_FROM
purpose: From address for Vault welcome, retention, and billing-support emails.

name: DATABASE_URL
purpose: Durable storage connection for Vault members, webhook idempotency, lifecycle emails, repair tasks, and referral attribution.

name: AUTH_SECRET
purpose: Server-side session signing or equivalent auth secret required before Vault member routes can unlock.

name: VAULT_FOUNDING_FILLED
purpose: Temporary static founding-seat count until persistent member storage is wired.

name: CONTEXTUAL_VAULT_CTA_ENABLED
purpose: Enables contextual Vault CTAs on proof surfaces.

name: PROOF_SURFACE_EMAIL_CAPTURE_ENABLED
purpose: Enables proof-surface email capture once storage is wired.
